mechanism: The now-playing page assigns the raw millisecond position from AVPlayer's timeUpdate callback into a page-level @State on every callback (~10/s). The whole player page (cover image, title, slider, controls) re-renders at callback frequency although the slider position and time labels only visibly change once per second, wasting UI-thread CPU throughout playback.
fix_summary: The state is assigned only when the whole-second part of the position changes.

performance_oracle.definition: Sampled retired-instruction period sum (hw-instructions) attributed to the app process in the complete externally driven measured window.
performance_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant
